claim_boundary: No product-superiority, SOTA, revolutionary, replacement, validation, or held-out claim is permitted unless an exact-SHA v2 admission artifact passes every frozen gate.

candidate.ingestion: Compile source-ordered memory into typed immutable fact, state-transition, constraint, and tombstone events. Preserve provenance and source order. Never inspect answers, gold labels, scorer fields, or split metadata during compilation.
candidate.reconciliation: Normalize subject and relation keys; a later explicit update supersedes an earlier value, an explicit deletion creates a tombstone, and a query may expose only active non-tombstoned claims plus the existence/category of a tombstone when the query asks what was removed.
candidate.retrieval: Hybrid deterministic lexical and hashing-vector retrieval over active claims, followed by at most four entity-linked graph expansion hops. Rank by query overlap, graph distance, source recency, and contradiction penalty under a fixed token budget.
candidate.abstention: Abstain when no active claim crosses the frozen retrieval floor, every candidate is tombstoned, constraints fail, or the token/latency budget cannot be met.
candidate.evaluation_only: Development shadow selection executes the same reconciler and selector without granting production eligibility. Candidate identity may change selection; promotion state may not be bypassed in production.
candidate.production_promotion: Unchanged causal rule: 95% paired cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound strictly greater than zero, at least five independent clusters, and zero false verified promotions.

allowed: MemoryAgentBench units labeled development in the frozen split manifest
MemOps subjects labeled development in the frozen evaluation split manifest
STATE-Bench development learning trajectories already prepared without validation/final execution
development_scope.candidate_changes_after_development_outc: A changed mechanism requires a new protocol version and digest; thresholds and the v2 admission gates may never be weakened.

development_gate.cluster_identity: content or subject fingerprint; repeated rows with the same fingerprint are one cluster
development_gate.absent_intervention_policy: A treatment row with zero selected memories or byte-identical treatment/control prompts is invalid for uplift estimation and must be reported, not coerced to zero effect.

terminal_rule: If the frozen v2 candidate does not pass the development gate, report failed_experiment_v2 and create no validation, held-out, admission, SOTA, or revolutionary claim. Public WaveField descriptions and WaveMind Connect remain unchanged.
